description: This file implements the core logic for the 'git bisect' command, handling commit selection, traversal, and related utilities to facilitate binary search to identify problematic commits.

methods.name: int count_distance(struct commit_list * entry)
methods.description: Calculates the distance of a commit chain from an endpoint, counting non-merge and interesting commits.

methods.name: void clear_distance(struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Resets the COUNTED flag on commits after distance computation to prepare for future calculations.

methods.name: int weight(struct commit_list * elem)
methods.description: Returns the weight (distance or relevance) of a commit in the bisect process.

methods.name: void weight_set(struct commit_list * elem,int weight)
methods.description: Sets the weight for a specific commit in the bisect evaluation.

methods.name: int count_interesting_parents(struct commit * commit,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Counts the number of interesting parent commits for a given commit.

methods.name: int approx_halfway(struct commit_list * p,int nr)
methods.description: Determines whether a commit is approximately halfway in the commit list based on weights.

methods.name: void show_list(const char * debug,int counted,int nr,struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Displays a list of commits for debugging purposes when DEBUG_BISECT is enabled.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Selects the commit closest to the midpoint in the commit list, optimizing the bisect process.

methods.name: int compare_commit_dist(const void * a_,const void * b_)
methods.description: Comparator for sorting commits based on their distance and OID for selecting the best bisect candidate.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection_sorted(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Returns the list of commits sorted by their distance from the midpoint, for refined bisecting.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * do_find_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr,int * weights,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Performs the core algorithm to identify the optimal commit to test next in the bisect process.

methods.name: void find_bisection(struct commit_list ** commit_list,int * reaches,int * all,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Orchestrates the process of finding the next commit to test during bisect, utilizing distance calculation and sorting.

methods.name: int register_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Registers references (like branches or tags) relevant to bisect, updating internal state.

methods.name: int read_bisect_refs(void)
methods.description: Reads bisect-related refs from the repository.

methods.name: char * join_oid_array_hex(struct oid_array * array,char delim)
methods.description: Creates a string of concatenated OID hex strings separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * filter_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried,int show_all,int * count,int * skipped_first)
methods.description: Filters out commits marked as skipped; optionally skips ahead using a pseudo-random selection.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * managed_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried)
methods.description: Handles skipped commits according to the user's input, possibly skipping further commits.

methods.name: void bisect_rev_setup(struct repository * r,struct rev_info * revs,struct strvec * rev_argv,const char * prefix,const char * bad_format,const char * good_format,int read_paths)
methods.description: Sets up the revision walk for bisect, including setting interest/relevance based on current state.

methods.name: void bisect_common(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Prepares the revision info for bisect operations, such as marking edges uninteresting.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error error_if_skipped_commits(struct commit_list * tried,const struct object_id * bad)
methods.description: Handles the case when only skipped commits remain, printing info and returning error.

methods.name: int is_expected_rev(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a revision matches the expected revision stored in the repository.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_checkout(const struct object_id * bisect_rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Checks out a commit for testing, updating refs like BISECT_HEAD and BISECT_EXPECTED_REV.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Returns the commit object for a given OID, erroring if invalid.

methods.name: struct:commit ** get_bad_and_good_commits(struct repository * r,size_t * rev_nr)
methods.description: Returns an array of commits including bad and good revisions for bisect processing.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error handle_bad_merge_base(void)
methods.description: Checks if the merge base is bad or meets certain expected conditions, returning appropriate error.

methods.name: void handle_skipped_merge_base(const struct object_id * mb)
methods.description: Warns the user when a merge base should be skipped during bisect.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_merge_bases(size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Verifies that merge bases are valid and suitable for bisect, potentially requiring user testing.

methods.name: int check_ancestors(struct repository * r,size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Checks whether all revisions are ancestors of a given revision.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_good_are_ancestors_of_bad(struct repository * r,const char * prefix,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Ensures all good revisions are ancestors of the bad revision, crucial for bisect correctness.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Displays a commit's information to the user using 'git show'.

methods.name: void read_bisect_terms(char ** read_bad,char ** read_good)
methods.description: Reads user-defined terms for bad/good labels in bisect from configuration.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next_all(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Main function for advancing the bisect process, determining the next commit to test.

methods.name: int estimate_bisect_steps(int all)
methods.description: Estimates how many steps are left in the bisect process based on total revisions.

methods.name: int mark_for_removal(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Marks refs for removal during cleanup of bisect state.

methods.name: int bisect_clean_state(void)
methods.description: Removes all bisect-related refs and files, resetting the repository state for a new bisect.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
